description: Chat endpoint HTTP latency trend across P1.27 soak windows (Y1-Y10) and smoke probes

smoke_probes.note: High latency due to LLM queuing at concurrency=5. Serial mode selected for main soak.

soak_windows: Y1-Y10 pending (serial mode, ~700ms p95 expected per smoke probe)

baseline_serial_mode.rationale: Serial mode bypasses LLM queue contention. Legacy chat orchestrator responds in 400-800ms per request.

trend_analysis.p126_to_p127_delta: N/A (P1.26 used non-chat endpoints; first real chat latency measurement in P1.27)
trend_analysis.concurrency_sensitivity: High — p95 increases from 709ms (serial) to 28141ms (concurrent=5) due to backend LLM serialization
trend_analysis.recommendation: Production soak should use multiple backend replicas behind a load balancer to achieve parallel throughput without LLM queuing
